description: Four string-operation survivors behind a type-only test; passes when the tests pass and every listed mutant is killed.

mutation-kill.task: Drive the surviving mutants of `lib/names.py` down in the Python project `{fixture}/` in the current working directory. `{fixture}/SURVIVORS.md` is the survivor report from the last mutmut run; mutmut is not installed, so do not run it. Add targeted pytest tests to `tests/test_names.py` that kill the listed survivors. Do not change `lib/names.py` or anything under `mutants/`. Verify from `{fixture}/` with `python3 -m pytest -q tests` and `python3 mutants/check_mutants.py`, commit on green, and end with one sentence giving the survivors killed.
